correctness.rationale: Equation (41) of arXiv:2310.03722 was inspected directly. After setting \(x=c^2\) and \(t=T_{n-1}^2\), exact algebra reduces the squared martingale to \(x(n+x)^{n-1}(n-1+t)^n/[n(n-1)+(n-1+t)x]^n\). Its log derivative has the sole sign factor \(-(x(t-1)-n)\), proving the optimizer and both boundary cases. Monotonicity in \(t\) and \(n\) and the Lambert-\(W\) limit are analytic. The packaged verifier reproduces representative identities and constants.

value.rationale: The source papers identify the precision parameter as a genuine finite-time power/tightness choice. Maximizing over it gives a natural structural envelope for the whole family, a sharp precision-independent necessary threshold for rejection, and an explicit asymptotic barrier. The theorem also clarifies that oracle comparison is diagnostic rather than a license for post-hoc e-value tuning.
